inlines.v: CONTEMPLATION, noun [Latin] 1. The act of the mind in considering with attention; meditation; study; continued attention of the mind to a particular subject. CONTEMPLATION is keeping the idea, brought into the mind, some time actually in view. 2. Holy meditation; attention to sacred things; a particular application of the foregoing definition. To have in contemplation to intend or purpose, or to have under consideration.
